Regime-flipper shots

Shots whose per-shot fits jump between trajectory regimes when physics constants change slightly, dominating the tails of every parameter study (see results_μw.md, results_muS.md, results_mus_muw_box.md).

Links pass the array index into shots.json (viewer.html?index=N). If a link opens the wrong shot, the file was refitted and reordered since this page was generated — use the dropdown inside the viewer instead. Generated: 2026-08-24.
